description: Retrieve Individual Assistance (IA) housing data for a disaster by disaster number. Returns owner and/or renter records aggregated by county, city, and ZIP code — valid registrations, total approved IHP amounts, repair/rental/other-needs amounts, and inspection counts (owners also carry inspected damage in USD). Narrow with state, county, or zip_code; owners_count, renters_count, and offset then count the filtered records. Use type to select owners, renters, or both (default). A page holds at most 100,000 characters of records, owners and renters cut at the same row count so one offset continues both; when records remain past it, next_offset is the offset to continue from. Use disaster_number from fema_search_disasters.

county.description: Filter by county name (e.g., Harris, dekalb). Case-insensitive substring match: harris also matches Harrison. OpenFEMA stores the county with its type, such as Harris (County) or Evangeline (Parish), and as the applicant reported it.

disaster_number.description: FEMA disaster number. Obtain from fema_search_disasters. Numbers above 32767 match no declaration.

limit.description: Maximum records per dataset to return (1–10000, default 100). A page also stops at 100,000 characters of owner and renter records together, cutting both datasets at the same row count; when either bound leaves matching records out, next_offset names the offset to continue from.

offset.description: Pagination offset into each queried dataset (default 0). Pass the previous page’s next_offset to continue both.

state.description: Two-letter state code to narrow results when a disaster spans multiple states.

type.description: Which housing assistance dataset to query: owners, renters, or both (default).

zip_code.description: Filter by 5-digit ZIP code, as a string with leading zeros kept (e.g., 77084, 00609). ZIP+4 is not accepted. One ZIP can return several records, one per county and city spelling.

name: fema_get_housing_assistance

county_filter.description: The county name both datasets were filtered by, trimmed, matched as a case-insensitive substring. Absent when county was not set.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_state`: The state parameter is not a valid 2-letter US state/territory code. `not_found`: The disaster number is above 32767, the highest number OpenFEMA holds, so no declaration exists. `request_too_long`: The county value makes the request URL longer than the roughly 8,900 characters OpenFEMA accepts. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page, for both datasets: offset plus the larger of the owner and renter record counts returned. Present only while records remain in a queried dataset; pass it as offset to continue.

notice.description: Zero-match guidance for supplied filters and declared programs, or paging guidance: the continuation offset and whether limit or the response budget ended the page, and each queried nonzero dataset’s total and last valid offset when past its end.

owners.description: Homeowner (HousingAssistanceOwners) records. Empty when type is "renters" or no owner data exists.

items.description: Homeowner housing assistance aggregated by county and ZIP for one disaster.

approved_for_fema_assistance.description: Number of homeowner registrations approved for any FEMA assistance; 0 when none were. Absent when not reported.

average_fema_inspected_damage.description: Average damage in USD, under FEMA's inspection guidelines, of the homeowners with a completed inspection; 0 when no damage was recorded or no one was inspected (see total_inspected). Measured separately from total_damage, so it is not total_damage divided by a count. Absent when not reported.

city.description: City name. Absent when not recorded.

county.description: County name. Absent when not recorded.

disaster_number.description: FEMA disaster number this record belongs to.

no_fema_inspected_damage.description: Number of inspected homeowner applicants whose inspector recorded no damage; 0 when there were none. Absent when not reported.

other_needs_amount.description: Other needs assistance (personal property, transportation, etc.) in USD; 0 when none was approved. Absent when not reported.

rental_amount.description: Rental assistance granted in USD; 0 when none was. Absent when not reported.

repair_replace_amount.description: Home repair and replacement assistance in USD; 0 when none was approved. Absent when not reported.

state.description: Two-letter state code. Absent when not recorded.

total_approved_ihp_amount.description: Total Individuals and Households Program (IHP) assistance approved in USD; 0 when none was. Absent when not reported.

total_damage.description: Total damage in USD recorded at the latest inspections: FEMA Verified Loss for real property (the home) and personal property, excluding transportation; 0 when none was recorded or no one was inspected (see total_inspected). Absent when not reported.

total_inspected.description: Number of homeowner applicants who received a FEMA inspection. 0 means no one in this area was inspected, so a 0 in average_fema_inspected_damage or total_damage then means not inspected, not $0 of damage. Absent when not reported.

valid_registrations.description: Number of valid IA registrations from homeowners in this area. Absent when not reported.

zip_code.description: 5-digit ZIP code; 00000 when OpenFEMA files the records under no ZIP code. Absent when not recorded.

owners_count.description: Total owner records matching the disaster and any state, county, or zip_code filter, before the per-dataset limit.

renters.description: Renter (HousingAssistanceRenters) records. Empty when type is "owners" or no renter data exists.

items.description: Renter housing assistance aggregated by county and ZIP for one disaster. Renter records carry no dollar damage figures.

approved_for_fema_assistance.description: Number of renter registrations approved for any FEMA assistance; 0 when none were. Absent when not reported.

city.description: City name. Absent when not recorded.

county.description: County name. Absent when not recorded.

disaster_number.description: FEMA disaster number this record belongs to.

other_needs_amount.description: Other needs assistance in USD; 0 when none was approved. Absent when not reported.

rental_amount.description: Rental assistance granted in USD; 0 when none was. Absent when not reported.

repair_replace_amount.description: Home repair and replacement assistance in USD as OpenFEMA records it for renters; 0 when none was approved, as in nearly every renter area, since FEMA's data dictionary notes renters are not eligible for it. Absent when not reported.

state.description: Two-letter state code. Absent when not recorded.

total_approved_ihp_amount.description: Total IHP assistance approved for renters in USD; 0 when none was. Absent when not reported.

total_inspected.description: Number of renter applicants who received a FEMA inspection; 0 when none did. Absent when not reported.

total_inspected_with_no_damage.description: Number of valid renter registrations assigned no damage. Renters get a damage degree rather than a full home inspection, so this and the other degree counts count registrations and can exceed total_inspected; 0 when there were none. Absent when not reported.

total_with_major_damage.description: Number of valid renter registrations assigned a major degree of damage, counted like total_inspected_with_no_damage; 0 when there were none. Absent when not reported.

total_with_moderate_damage.description: Number of valid renter registrations assigned a moderate degree of damage, counted like total_inspected_with_no_damage; 0 when there were none. Absent when not reported.

total_with_substantial_damage.description: Number of valid renter registrations assigned a substantial degree of damage, counted like total_inspected_with_no_damage; 0 when there were none. Absent when not reported.

valid_registrations.description: Number of valid IA registrations from renters in this area. Absent when not reported.

zip_code.description: 5-digit ZIP code; 00000 when OpenFEMA files the records under no ZIP code. Absent when not recorded.

renters_count.description: Total renter records matching the disaster and any state, county, or zip_code filter, before the per-dataset limit.

totalCount.description: Total owner + renter records available before the per-dataset limit — exceeds the returned count when either dataset was capped.

zip_code_filter.description: The 5-digit ZIP code both datasets were filtered by. Absent when zip_code was not set.

title: Get FEMA Housing Assistance Data
